body:
Runner trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-30, my own miss on the w-2144 test-ref full gate test-bf74aad3 on the Mac, which failed 6740/7). The Mac launch used `env -i … PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`. The Mac's `claude` CLI lives at ~/.local/bin/claude, so every tests::orchestrator::* test that creates an orchestrator instance panicked with "Install the `claude` CLI and make sure it is executable on PATH" (7 tests). DL560's runner PATH already starts with $HOME/.local/bin and resolves claude.
Rule: every Mac launch PATH must include $HOME/.local/bin, first: PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin. Before a remote full gate on a new host, check `env -i … sh -c 'command -v claude'` in the exact runner environment. A whole-binary Mac run made with the old PATH that shows these 7 orchestrator tests failing is this environment defect, not product evidence.
Second trap, same session, twice: I launched a Windows B wrapper by path before creating and staging it ("No such file or directory"; nothing ran). Stage the wrapper and confirm it remotely (`bash -n PATH && echo present`) before the background launch.
